name: Volumetric Toon Shading
definition: A non-photorealistic rendering technique for volumetric data that simulates toon shading (cel shading) by computing lighting per-fragment using a 3D normal map and hardware texture combiners, avoiding the need for explicit surface vertices.
summary: Volumetric Toon Shading is a non-photorealistic technique that applies cel shading to volumes using a 3D normal map, avoiding mesh extraction by operating directly on fragment-level gradient data.
